verdict.rationale: Gecko produces AI-generated insights from the user's own code inside the product. Each finding includes a severity, a confidence score, the source-to-sink call chain, a proof of concept and a suggested patch, and the product also writes an AI repository wiki of architecture and security model plus PR security review summaries. Hands-on reports describe false positives scored at 100% confidence and missed real issues, which questions the accuracy of these insights but not whether they are delivered. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that the insights are accurate (community reports point the other way), and evidence of interactive or conversational insight querying inside the product itself.
